experiment_scope: Live-capable A/B listening harness for isolating the audible impact of VOICE-026 interaction prosody. The same improved English or German ElevenLabs custom voice is used for both variants. Both variants keep VOICE-022 spoken normalization and VOICE-023/025 speech realism enabled; only VOICE-026 interaction-prosody changes.

variants.label: VOICE-025 baseline without VOICE-026 interaction prosody
variants.expected_role: current boundary-aware filler-placement baseline without lookup acknowledgements or backchannels

variants.label: With VOICE-026 interaction prosody
variants.expected_role: same voice and script with lookup acknowledgements, neutral backchannels, and bounded sales pace cues enabled
